		ManagedS3Credentials: s3Credentials,
		WorkloadIdentity:     WorkloadIdentity{UID: 65534, GID: 65534},
		PollInterval:         250 * time.Millisecond, ClockCheck: func() error { return nil }})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create native host agent: %v", err)
	}
	agentCtx, stopAgent := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer stopAgent()
	agentDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { agentDone <- agent.Run(agentCtx) }()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(120 * time.Second)
	var report Report
	var lastReports []Report
	var lastHostError error
	var lastHostCount int
	var lastHostVerified bool
	var lastSessionExpiry time.Time
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		select {
		case err := <-agentDone:
			t.Fatalf("native agent stopped before running report: %v", err)
		default:
		}
		hosts, err := controller.ListHosts(t.Context())
		lastHostError = err
		if err == nil {
			lastHostCount = len(hosts)
			if len(hosts) == 1 {
				lastHostVerified = hosts[0].Verified
				lastSessionExpiry = hosts[0].SessionExpiresAt
				lastReports = hosts[0].Reports
			}
		}
		if err == nil && len(hosts) == 1 && hosts[0].Verified && len(hosts[0].Reports) == 1 &&
			hosts[0].Reports[0].State == "running" && hosts[0].Reports[0].Managed != nil {
			report = hosts[0].Reports[0]
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(250 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if report.Managed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("no accepted signed managed running report within deadline: host count=%d verified=%t session expiry=%s; last host error: %v; last reports: %+v",
			lastHostCount, lastHostVerified, lastSessionExpiry.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), lastHostError, lastReports)
	}

stopAgent()
	select {
	case <-agentDone:
	case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("native agent did not stop")
	}
	fmt.Printf("TS_MANAGED_MEMBER_PHASE=PASS node=%s\n", cfg.Node)

func sameManagedDrainOperation(left, right ManagedDrainCommand) bool {
	left.Epoch, right.Epoch = 0, 0
	return left == right
}

func (command ManagedDrainCommand) matchesDesired(desired Desired, registration Registration) bool {
	launch := desired.ManagedMember
	return entityid.Valid(command.OperationID) &&
		command.Node == desired.Node && command.Role == desired.Role && command.Epoch != 0 &&
		command.DesiredGeneration == desired.Generation && command.ExpectedETag != "" &&
		launch != nil && launch.Runtime != nil && !desired.Withdrawn && command.Member == launch.Member &&
		command.Authority == launch.Authority && command.OCI == launch.OCI &&
		command.VolumeID == launch.VolumeID && command.AttachmentID == launch.AttachmentID &&
		registration.ManagedMember != nil && *registration.ManagedMember == command.Member &&
		registration.ManagedOCI != nil && *registration.ManagedOCI == command.OCI &&
		command.ExpectedProcess.PID >= 2 && lowerHex(command.ExpectedProcess.StartNonce, 32) &&
		command.Survivor.MemberID == launch.Runtime.ReplicationPeerMemberID &&
		command.Survivor.MemberID != command.Member.Scope.MemberID &&
		lowerHexIdentity(command.Survivor.Incarnation)
}

func expectedHostMaterialDigest(desired Desired, name string) string {
	launch := desired.ManagedMember
	if launch == nil || launch.Runtime == nil {
		return ""
	}
	switch name {
	case "authority.tbca":
		return launch.Authority.CertificateSHA256
	case "trusted-public-key":
		return launch.Runtime.TrustedKeySHA256
	case "server.crt":
		return launch.Runtime.ServerCertificateSHA256
	case "server.key":
		return launch.Runtime.ServerPrivateKeySHA256
	case "client-ca.pem":
		return launch.Runtime.ClientCARootsSHA256
	case "server-ca.pem":
		return launch.Runtime.ReplicationServerCASHA256
	case "client-managed-manifest.json":
		return launch.Runtime.ClientManagedMaterialManifestSHA256
	case "signed-v2-s3-config.json":
		return launch.Runtime.LiveS3ConfigSHA256
	case sqlSchemaBundleName:
		return launch.Runtime.SQLSchemaBundleSHA256
	case backupManifestFileName:
		return launch.Runtime.BackupManifestSHA256
	case backupS3ConfigFileName:
		return launch.Runtime.BackupS3ConfigSHA256
	default:
		return ""
	}
}
